cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the open side door of a camper van parked by a lake at night — perched on a ledge or edge; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake at chest height; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — loops the strap of a camera over her head; the top of a restored ancient city wall — standing; a western coastal signal tower with an open gallery and a large brass viewing telescope on a fixed stand — she is a signal-keeper taking a break after looking through the telescope; her crew cabin aboard a starship — holds a book closed against her chest; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — kneeling on the ground; an esports arena — rests a pair of inflatable cheering sticks against her shoulder; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a mossy path under ancient oaks with shafts of light — standing; a neon-lit game arcade — fixes a slice of fruit onto the rim of a cocktail glass; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — lifts a folding fan open to just below her eyes; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — lying on her front
